atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
coilLookback = input(100, "Coil Lookback", 20, 200, 1)
rangeLookback = input(20, "Range Lookback", 5, 100, 1)
vovShort = input(10, "Vol-of-Vol Short", 3, 50, 1)
vovLong = input(30, "Vol-of-Vol Long", 5, 80, 1)
predictLen = input(20, "Predictability Length", 5, 60, 1)
releaseMult = input(1.5, "Release Multiplier", 1.1, 3.0, 0.1)
coilThresh = input(80, "Coil Threshold", 50, 95, 1)
predictThresh = input(55, "Predictability Threshold", 10, 90, 1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

tr1 = high - low
tr2 = abs(high - close[1])
tr3 = abs(low - close[1])
trMax1 = max(tr1, tr2)
trueRange = max(trMax1, tr3)
atrVal = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)

rangeNow = high - low
rangeMax = highest(rangeNow, rangeLookback)
rangeFloor = lowest(rangeNow, rangeLookback)
rangeRatio = rangeNow / (rangeMax + 0.0000000001)

atrMax = highest(atrVal, coilLookback)
atrMin = lowest(atrVal, coilLookback)
coilLoad = 100 * (1 - (atrVal - atrMin) / (atrMax - atrMin + 0.0000000001))

rangeCoil = 100 * (1 - rangeRatio)
rangeCoilBoost = min(rangeCoil * 1.2, 100)
combinedCoil = min(coilLoad, rangeCoilBoost)

vovS = stdev(atrVal, vovShort)
vovL = stdev(atrVal, vovLong)
vovRatio = vovS / (vovL + 0.0000000001)
vovRising = vovRatio > 1.0

netMove = abs(close - close[predictLen])
path = 0.0
k = 1
while k <= predictLen {
    path = path + abs(close[k] - close[k - 1])
    k = k + 1
}
efficiency = netMove / (path + 0.0000000001)
predictable = 100 * efficiency

loaded = combinedCoil >= coilThresh and vovRising
warmup = bar_index > coilLookback

buyRaw = warmup and loaded[1] and vovRising and rangeNow > releaseMult * rangeFloor and close > open and close > high[1]
sellRaw = warmup and loaded[1] and vovRising and rangeNow > releaseMult * rangeFloor and close < open and close < low[1]
buyRelease = buyRaw and not buyRaw[1]
sellRelease = sellRaw and not sellRaw[1]

buyStrong = buyRelease and predictable >= predictThresh
sellStrong = sellRelease and predictable >= predictThresh
buyWeak = buyRelease and predictable < predictThresh
sellWeak = sellRelease and predictable < predictThresh

atrScaled = atrVal / (atrMax + 0.0000000001) * 100
releaseSpike = buyRelease or sellRelease ? rangeNow / (rangeMax + 0.0000000001) * 100 : 0.0

if buyRelease { plotshape(bar_index, low, "Release Up", "triangleup", "#22cc88") }
if sellRelease { plotshape(bar_index, high, "Release Dn", "triangledown", "#ff4477") }
if buyStrong { plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Strong Up", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.0 * markerSize, 0, "separate") }
if sellStrong { plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Strong Dn", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.0 * markerSize, 0, "separate") }
if buyWeak { plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Weak Up", "coneup", "#8a8f98", 1.0 * markerSize, 0, "separate") }
if sellWeak { plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Weak Dn", "conedown", "#8a8f98", 1.0 * markerSize, 0, "separate") }

plot(combinedCoil, "Combined Coil", "#2dd4bf", 2, "separate")
plot(predictable, "Predictable", "#ff9f1c", 2, "separate")
plot(atrScaled, "ATR Coil", "#8a8f98", 1, "separate")
hline(coilThresh, "#2dd4bf", "separate")
hline(predictThresh, "#ff9f1c", "separate")
plot3d(combinedCoil, "Coil Load", "ribbon", "#2dd4bf", "separate", 0)
plot3d(predictable, "Predictable", "ribbon", "#ff9f1c", "separate", 1)
plot3d(releaseSpike, "Release Spike", "bars3d", "#ffd43b", "separate", 2)

SessionLength = input(20, "Session Length", 10, 100, 1)
StructureLength = input(20, "Structure Length", 10, 100, 1)
ConfirmBars = input(2, "Confirm Bars", 1, 10, 1)
StopOffsetTicks = input(10, "Stop Offset Ticks", 1, 100, 1)
MinStructureQuality = input(60, "Min Structure Quality", 0, 100, 1)

sessHigh = highest(high, SessionLength)
sessLow = lowest(low, SessionLength)
sessMid = (sessHigh + sessLow) / 2
sessHighPrev = sessHigh[1]
sessLowPrev = sessLow[1]

h1High = security("1h", high)
h1Low = security("1h", low)
h1Close = security("1h", close)

swingHigh = highest(h1High, StructureLength)
swingLow = lowest(h1Low, StructureLength)
prevSwingHigh = swingHigh[1]
prevSwingLow = swingLow[1]

bullBreak = h1Close > prevSwingHigh
bearBreak = h1Close < prevSwingLow

lowestH1 = lowest(h1Close, ConfirmBars)
highestH1 = highest(h1Close, ConfirmBars)
bullConfirmed = bullBreak and lowestH1 > prevSwingHigh
bearConfirmed = bearBreak and highestH1 < prevSwingLow

noOppBullBonus = lowestH1 > prevSwingLow ? 25 : 0
noOppBearBonus = highestH1 < prevSwingHigh ? 25 : 0
dispBullBonus = bullBreak ? 25 : 0
dispBearBonus = bearBreak ? 25 : 0
qualityBull = 50 + dispBullBonus + noOppBullBonus
qualityBear = 50 + dispBearBonus + noOppBearBonus

tickProxy = abs(close * 0.0001) + 0.00001
longStopLvl = sessLow - StopOffsetTicks * tickProxy
shortStopLvl = sessHigh + StopOffsetTicks * tickProxy
longRiskPct = (close - longStopLvl) / close * 100
shortRiskPct = (shortStopLvl - close) / close * 100
confBull = qualityBull / 100
confBear = qualityBear / 100

var inLong = 0.0
var inShort = 0.0

buySig = crossover(close, sessHighPrev) and bullConfirmed and qualityBull >= MinStructureQuality
sellSig = crossunder(close, sessLowPrev) and bearConfirmed and qualityBear >= MinStructureQuality
exitLongSig = crossunder(close, sessMid) or low <= longStopLvl
exitShortSig = crossover(close, sessMid) or high >= shortStopLvl
exitLong = exitLongSig and inLong == 1.0
exitShort = exitShortSig and inShort == 1.0

if buySig {
    model.confidence(confBull)
    model.stopLoss(longRiskPct)
    model.longEntry("siege-long")
    inLong := 1.0
    inShort := 0.0
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    model.confidence(confBear)
    model.stopLoss(shortRiskPct)
    model.shortEntry("siege-short")
    inShort := 1.0
    inLong := 0.0
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if exitLong {
    model.longExit("siege-long")
    inLong := 0.0
}
if exitShort {
    model.shortExit("siege-short")
    inShort := 0.0
}

plot(sessHigh, "Session High", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(sessLow, "Session Low", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
plot(sessMid, "Session Mid", "#ffcc33", 1, "stepline")
plot(longStopLvl, "Long Stop", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
plot(shortStopLvl, "Short Stop", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
